<|det|>title [68, 256, 178, 273]<|/det|>Description <|det|>text [66, 295, 930, 323]<|/det|>A uint32 value from protobuf is downcast to uint8 without bounds checking, potentially causing data truncation if the source value exceeds 255. <|det|>text [68, 338, 451, 352]<|/det|>The code performs an unchecked integer downcast. <|det|>text [73, 361, 532, 427]<|/det|>api/proxy/store/generated_key/eigenda/verify/verifier.go qps := make([QuorumBobParam, len(c.BobHeader.getBobbQuorumParams()) for i, qp := range c.BobHeader.GetBobbQuorumParams() { qps[i] = QuorumBobParam[ QuorumNumber: uint(qp.GetQuorumNumber()), // mosec G15 ] <|det|>text [66, 437, 930, 499]<|/det|>The qp.GetQuorumNumber() function returns a uint32 value from the protobuf definition, but it is directly cast to uint8 without validating that the value is within the valid range (0-255). If a malformed or malicious protobuf message contains a quorum number greater than 255, the cast will silently truncate the value, potentially leading to incorrect quorum processing. <|det|>title [68, 533, 238, 548]<|/det|>Recommendations <|det|>text [67, 571, 388, 586]<|/det|>Add bounds checking before the downcast. <|det|>title [68, 620, 168, 635]<|/det|>Resolution <|det|>text [66, 658, 925, 687]<|/det|>The development team have added bounds checking by implementing a check against the constant MaxQuorumID = 191 in PR #2108. <|det|>footer [75, 925, 204, 944]<|/det|>sigmaprime <|det|>page_number [810, 931, 881, 945]<|/det|>Page | 23
